result.instructions: Tools for Timesheets.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Who clocked in today, and who is still on the clock?"; "Give me the hourly report for last month, grouped by customer."; "Which projects did the team log time to in October, and how many hours?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Timesheets.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run timesheets_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run timesheets_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run timesheets_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. timesheets_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: timesheets_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users of the company, with UserID, name, email, access level and status. Filter by user ids and status. Timesheets API: GET /users.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated UserIDs. Omit for all users.

tools.name: timesheets_get_user_info
tools.title: Get user info
tools.description: Get report details for users: name, pay and tracking settings, supervisor. Empty user_ids returns all users. Timesheets API: GET /report/user/info.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated UserIDs. Omit for all users.

tools.name: timesheets_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Create a user in the company. Sends an invitation email only when send_notification_email is true (default false). Timesheets API: POST /user.

access_level.description: EMP employee, SUPER supervisor, ADMIN administrator.

supervisor_id.description: Report-to user. Needed for SUPER and EMP.

tools.name: timesheets_assign_user_items
tools.title: Assign items to a user
tools.description: Add customers, projects or account codes to a user. Existing assignments stay. Set defaults with default_id (customer, project) or the default_*_id fields (accountcode). Timesheets API: POST /user/{UserID}/customers|projects|accountcodes.

default_id.description: customer or project only. Must be in item_ids.

tools.name: timesheets_unassign_user_items
tools.title: Remove items from a user
tools.description: Remove customers, projects or account codes from a user. Only the listed ids are removed. Removing a default resets it to the company default. Timesheets API: DELETE /user/{UserID}/customers|projects|accountcodes.

tools.name: timesheets_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List customers, projects, account codes, vendors or events. Filter by status, text and ids. Timesheets API: GET /items/{kind}.

status.description: Type-specific status, for example CUSTOMERSTATUS_ACTIVE. Default: active items.

tools.name: timesheets_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one customer, project, account code, vendor or event by id. Timesheets API: GET /item/{kind}/{id}.

tools.name: timesheets_create_vendor
tools.title: Create a vendor
tools.description: Create a vendor (used on expense records). Timesheets API: POST /item/vendor/0.

tools.name: timesheets_update_vendor
tools.title: Update a vendor
tools.description: Change fields of one vendor. Only the given fields change. Timesheets API: PATCH /item/vendor/{id}.

tools.name: timesheets_create_event
tools.title: Create an event
tools.description: Create an event (an expense or activity tag). Timesheets API: POST /item/event/0.

tools.name: timesheets_update_event
tools.title: Update an event
tools.description: Change the name or description of one event. Timesheets API: PATCH /item/event/{id}.

tools.name: timesheets_get_clock_shift
tools.title: Get a user's clock shift
tools.description: Get a user's current clock status: clock-in and break times, location, hours for the shift and for today. Needs admin access to that user. Timesheets API: GET /clock/shift/user/{UserID} (key only).

tools.name: timesheets_list_clock_shifts
tools.title: List clock shifts
tools.description: List clock status for several users, or for the users one supervisor manages. Timesheets API: GET /clock/shift/users (key only).

supervisor_id.description: Limit to users this manager supervises.

tools.name: timesheets_list_project_timers
tools.title: List project timers
tools.description: List a user's running project timers, optionally by customer, project or account code. Timesheets API: GET /project/timers/{UserID}.

tools.name: timesheets_get_record_history
tools.title: Get record history
tools.description: Get the revision history of one hourly, project or expense record. Needs admin access to the record's employee. Timesheets API: GET /record/{kind}/history/{RecordID}.

tools.name: timesheets_get_hourly_report
tools.title: Get an hourly time report
tools.description: Get an hourly time report for a date range, grouped and summarised or detailed. Processed = approved and finished records; unprocessed = the rest. Timesheets API: POST /report/hourly/customizable/{processed|unprocessed}.

all_users.description: Default true when user_ids is empty.

all_account_codes.description: Default true when account_code_ids is empty.

group_type.description: For example User, Job Title, Supervisor, Customer, Account Code, Date, None.

tools.name: timesheets_list_payroll_periods
tools.title: List hourly payroll periods
tools.description: List hourly payroll periods that start and end in a date range. Timesheets API: GET /report/hourly/payroll/periods.

tools.name: timesheets_get_payroll_period
tools.title: Get one hourly payroll period
tools.description: Get the hourly payroll report of one period, optionally for some users. Timesheets API: GET /report/hourly/payroll/period/{PayrollID}.

tools.name: timesheets_preview_payroll
tools.title: Preview an hourly payroll run
tools.description: Preview the hourly payroll for a date range and users. It is a preview: the call does not close a payroll period. Timesheets API: POST /report/hourly/payroll/preview.

tools.name: timesheets_get_project_report
tools.title: Get a project time report
tools.description: Get a project time report for a date range, by user, customer, project or account code. Timesheets API: POST /report/project/customizable.

all_users.description: Default true when user_ids is empty.

all_customers.description: Default true when customer_ids is empty.

all_projects.description: Default true when project_ids is empty.

all_account_codes.description: Default true when account_code_ids is empty.

tools.name: timesheets_get_expense_report
tools.title: Get an expense report
tools.description: Get an expense report for a date range, by user, vendor, event, customer, project or account code. Timesheets API: POST /report/expense/customizable.

all_users.description: Default true when user_ids is empty.

all_vendors.description: Default true when vendor_ids is empty.

all_events.description: Default true when event_ids is empty.

all_customers.description: Default true when customer_ids is empty.

all_projects.description: Default true when project_ids is empty.

all_account_codes.description: Default true when account_code_ids is empty.

tools.name: timesheets_get_server_reference
tools.title: Get server reference data
tools.description: Get the company's enum constants (user statuses, access types, record statuses) or the timezone ids used by timesheets_create_user. Timesheets API: GET /server/constants or /server/timezones.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Timesheets.com
prompts.description: What you can do with Timesheets.com here, with example requests to try.
